info.title: TiDB Agent Workspace · Local Prototype API
info.description: A loopback Workspace gateway with opt-in real TiDB Cloud Zero MySQL and Singapore Drive9 files. Existing local resources remain demos. Workspace Keys authorize actions and resources; upstream credentials stay internal. Zero trials expire; cloud usage is unmeasured. Production identity and public hosting are deferred.

post.description: Required workspace key scope: queries:execute. Resource operations also require the target in resourceIds (or an explicit wildcard). Lists are filtered to permitted resources. The local owner session may also call this endpoint.

sql.description: Live Zero: one statement up to 64 KiB, a 15-second deadline, at most 1000 result rows / 1 MiB. queries:execute allows reads and writes under the internal database role. No persistent session or automatic retry. A timeout or result limit can leave writes committed; check before retrying. Demo resources accept only SELECT 1 [AS connected] or SELECT * FROM agent_events [LIMIT n].
